milestone: Architecture finding resolutions and implementation proposal
scope: Specification edits only; no implementation or lifecycle approval. Historical review artifacts remain unchanged.

resolutions.resolution: Required digest-bound recording-set manifest; exact index/worktree validation shared by CLI/core; no blanket staging; explicit rollback and force limits.
Canonical checkout leases plus ordered repository/plan/checkout locks, non-plan coverage, delegated worker recovery and mutation-time revalidation.
Closed test reference and execution receipt schema, ledger binding, reporter-derived counts, expected suites and shared negative fixtures.

validation.warning_dispositions: Historical dispositions remain tied to their old hashes; unchanged counts do not refresh those dispositions or prove semantic correctness.

implementation_proposal.title: Implement extension-owned workflows and shared core
implementation_proposal.dependencies: Check current conductor plan overlap and live dependency state before plan creation; do not assume the older conductor design is the implementation target.

steps.title: Core API and shared schemas
steps.scope: Expose specplane/core, typed operation dispatch, closed workflow/manifest/receipt schemas and shared fixtures; retain manual command behavior except explicitly specified migrations.
steps.acceptance: CLI and library reject malformed and unknown inputs consistently; package export imports successfully.

steps.title: Writer leases and recovery
steps.scope: Implement checkout/repository coordination, ordered plan leases, delegation, cancellation and recovery.
steps.acceptance: Two non-plan writers and mixed plan/non-plan writers cannot overlap; dead parent/live worker, aliases, installation and cross-checkout races fail safely.

steps.title: Contribution capture and commit metadata
steps.scope: Capture and deduplicate contribution events; preserve repeated trailers and revision-linked unknown/model/subagent contributors.
steps.acceptance: Same-session model switches and later contributors are retained; unknown identity remains unknown; rewrites preserve origin.

steps.title: Prepared workflows, evidence and recording
steps.scope: Implement snapshot validation, core execution receipts and exact edit-set recording for both manual CLI and library; update shared recording procedure.
steps.acceptance: Unrelated staged and plan-folder edits refuse; partial staging refuses; failed commit restores index; stale evidence and skipped child assertions cannot pass; retry does not duplicate commits.

steps.title: Human gates and neutral manual lifecycle
steps.scope: Add direct revision-bound confirmations, neutral startup/init guidance and explicit extension-owned conductor entry; remove standalone automated run surfaces per target.
steps.acceptance: Stale/reused/model-generated confirmations refuse; manual lifecycle remains complete; no implicit runtime selection or cross-host fallback.

steps.title: Package compatibility and installation migration
steps.scope: Deliver versioned core/assets/procedures with digests, containment checks, journaled migration, collision handling and co-installation rules.
steps.acceptance: Dangling links refuse without outside writes; customized assets survive; interrupted upgrades recover; incompatible packages never activate partial command sets.

steps.title: Host integrations and release verification
steps.scope: Deliver complete procedures and Codex persistent runner; implement Claude handlers only against verified installed declarations. Review pins after target commits and implementation review.
steps.acceptance: Normal remote-backed steps synchronize, execute real tests, record and publish; broken nested-test fixture fails; live capability evidence names host versions, otherwise native/background capabilities remain unavailable.

gates: Human review of architecture resolutions and approval of proposed decomposition before draft plan creation.
Resolve spec eligibility before readiness/start; Codex specifications remain draft and ADR 0005 proposed.
Create plan through CLI; readiness is a separate human decision; implementation only in designated plan checkout.
Refresh specification pins against committed targets; skill pins only after implementation conformance review.
